analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: Muscle relaxants acting via HTR1A and CA1 have limited transcriptional impact in these cell lines because HTR1A is a neuronal GPCR with low expression and CA1 inhibition produces minimal gene-expression changes; the closest reference classes are other GABAergic modulators and serotonin/carbonic anhydrase agents, but overall the response should be weak.
